about: Third held-out intent set. Written BEFORE the embedding classifier existed and before any classifier score had been seen, so it measures the classifier's generalisation rather than its coverage. Sets 1 and 2 are retained but were both written against the rule-based router: set 1 is burned outright (its contents informed fixes), and set 2 was seen before a change was made. This file is the clean measurement for the classifier. If it is ever used to tune anything, it must be retired the same way and a fourth set written.
